steps.step: 1. CHO registered the mother for ANC; sex F and assigned CHO recorded on the server
1b. Registering the same mother again shows "Possible duplicate contacts found"; the existing record stays and nothing new is saved
2. "First ANC visit due" task appeared for the new mother
3. Pregnancy recorded with the EDD as typed
4. ANC booking saved: out-of-range weight had to be confirmed; missing vitals, danger sign and follow-up date derived
5. Concern, missing-assessment and follow-up tasks appeared; first-visit task resolved
6. Referral started from the concern task (state created)
7. Follow-up task resolved with a reason; the task left the list
8. Newborn registered with the mother link; delivery recorded against the pregnancy, listing the child
9. Newborn PNC saved against the child, linked to the mother and delivery
10. CWC visit saved with one recorded dose (no schedule or due date shown)
11. Appointment due today raised a task; recording it missed raised the missed-appointment task
12. Mother profile shows stage, band, next due, pregnancy, delivery and referral cards
13. The receiving facility's coordinator got "Referral awaiting acknowledgement" and acknowledged it; the event names the coordinator
13b. The originating CHO sees the receiving facility and "Acknowledged by rseidu" on the mother's referral card
14. Supervisor targets list the maternal and child counts
15. Full history kept: pregnancy, ANC, delivery, resolution and referral (created → acknowledged); the server refused a CHO edit and delete

detail.edit: CareLink coordination records are append-only; submit a new event instead.

steps.step: 16. All 10 clinical records carry approval_status pending_clinical_review
17. CHO replicates her own Tolon records but not a Nyankpala household (direct read returned 403)
18. CWC visit saved offline, kept after an offline reload, then synchronized to the server

note: Made-up people marked record_origin test. Tasks and states are derived from recorded events; no clinical schedule is applied.
